title: Commission approves €9 billion Spanish capacity mechanism for security of electricity supply
summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 29 May 2026 The European Commission has approved, under EU State aid rules, a €9 billion capacity mechanism for electricity supply for Spain. This aid measure aims to ensure that there is sufficient capacity to produce, store or flexibly consume electricity and that electricity production meets the expected demand.
